project_name: SAP BOM Viewer & Enterprise Procurement Portal

typography.anti_default_rule: Do not default to Inter or Arial for headlines. Use Chivo for section titles and JetBrains Mono for monetary values and item codes.

hierarchy.section_heading: text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-[#344054] font-heading (Chivo)
hierarchy.table_header: text-xs font-bold uppercase text-[#344054] font-heading bg-[#EAECF0]
hierarchy.body: text-xs sm:text-sm font-sans (IBM Plex Sans) text-[#344054]

visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-[0_1px_2px_0_rgba(16,24,40,0.05)] for cards; no soft blurred floating glow
visual_enhancers.data_density: Compact enterprise table padding (py-1.5 px-2.5) with direct grid borders
visual_enhancers.split_schedule_connector: Left border accent (3px solid #004B87) or tree branch indicator (└─) for split delivery child rows

grids.layout_mode: MODE B: High Density Grid (Enterprise Procurement / Analytics)

layouts.header: Fixed h-16 bg-[#0E7C86] with logo, NavTabs, and SapConnectionStatus
layouts.body: Max width 1400px centered with responsive padding px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-4
layouts.line_items_table: Dense border-collapsed table with sticky headers and explicit schedule split groupings

motion.transitions: transition-colors duration-150 ease-in-out for buttons and row hovers
motion.micro_interactions: Subtle scale or background highlight on split button click
motion.no_universal_transition: Do not use transition: all. Target specific CSS properties.

accessibility.interactive_elements: All buttons, inputs, selects, and status indicators must carry data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case.

media.use_icons: @phosphor-icons/react (Calendar, Truck, Plus, Trash, Copy, Split, CheckCircle, WarningCircle, ShieldCheck, ListChecks, FileMagnifyingGlass)
media.image_usage: Functional enterprise icons and badges only. Stock photos are excluded for this backend ERP table view.

3d_libraries.reason: Enterprise SAP procurement application requires flat high-density data tables for functional legibility.

split_delivery_schedule_redesign.problem_addressed: Buyers lacked clarity on how to split a Purchase Requisition item into multiple delivery dates. The action was represented by an ambiguous 'Duplicate row' copy icon button without context, labels, or allocation feedback.

1_microcopy_and_action_button.tooltip_text: Split this PR item into multiple delivery dates & partial quantities

2_visual_grouping_treatment.group_container: Grouped table block with a distinct light blue accent background (#F0F7FF) and a 3px left border accent (#004B87)
2_visual_grouping_treatment.group_header: Header badge showing 'PR Line #{prLineNo} · {count} Scheduled Deliveries' with total PR quantity
2_visual_grouping_treatment.child_row_indicator: Tree-connector icon (└─) or 'Delivery #2' badge distinguishing child schedule rows from parent

states.under_allocated: Yellow/Amber badge: '60 / 100 EA allocated (40 EA remaining)'
states.fully_allocated: Green check badge: '100 / 100 EA fully scheduled'
states.over_allocated: Red error alert: '120 / 100 EA - Exceeds PR qty by 20 EA'

3_allocation_progress_indicator.visual_element: Compact inline progress bar in the table cell under the Qty input

4_inline_guidance.location: Top of Line Items Engine card or sticky helper popup
4_inline_guidance.content: 💡 Delivery Split Tip: To schedule staggered shipments for a single PR line item, click 'Split Schedule' on the row. Adjust quantities and target delivery dates for each batch until total matches approved PR quantity.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the redesigned Split Delivery Schedule interaction in frontend/src/pages/PurchaseOrderPage.jsx.
Replace the plain Copy icon button with an explicitly labeled button: 'Split Schedule' with a Calendar or Truck icon and clear tooltip.
Add visual grouping for rows sharing the same prLineNo, using a 3px left border (#004B87), light background shading (#F0F7FF), and a schedule sub-header badge.
Redesign the allocation indicator below the quantity input into a clear progress bar & status badge (Green for exact match, Amber for remaining, Red for overflow).
Add an inline guidance banner above the line items table explaining how to split shipments into batches.
Ensure all new interactive elements contain role-based data-testid attributes for automated testing.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.avoid_ai_slop: Do not default to generic centered designs or unstyled tables. Use JDE enterprise table borders, high contrast headers, and strict typography hierarchy.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_universal_transition: Do not apply transition: all. Apply transitions specifically to hover and focus states.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid: Every button, input, tab, select, and status badge MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.color_contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA contrast standards (minimum 4.5:1 ratio).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Maintain 12px to 16px container padding for card containers to prevent text collisions with borders.
